site.home.faq.title: Questions doctors ask us
site.home.faq.trial.a: Yes, with every feature and no card needed. When it ends you choose a plan or your account pauses; your data stays safe and you can export it.
site.home.faq.setup.a: You can see patients the same day. Setup covers your practice, hours, services and team, and we can walk you through it on a call.
site.home.faq.data.q: Can I bring my existing patient data?
site.home.faq.data.a: Yes. Upload Excel or CSV yourself, or send us an export from your old software and we move it for you. You check it before go-live.
site.home.faq.where.a: Indian clinics are hosted in India and UAE clinics in the UAE. Records never leave their country.
site.home.faq.ai.q: Does the AI write notes without me?
site.home.faq.ai.a: No. Medvya Assist only drafts, and only after the patient agrees to recording. Nothing enters the record until you approve it.
site.home.faq.phone.q: Does it work on a phone or without internet?
site.home.faq.phone.a: Yes. Medvya runs on phones and tablets, and the front desk keeps working through short internet cuts. Changes sync when you are back online.
site.home.faq.payments.q: Which payment methods can patients use?
site.home.faq.payments.a.IN: UPI (QR, pay link or AutoPay), cards, net banking and cash.
site.home.faq.payments.a.AE: Cards, Apple Pay, bank transfer, cash and insurance through eClaimLink.
